facts.fact: StackAdapt sponsored 15 girls to attend the Technovation World Summit in Santa Clara, California in 2024.
facts.quote: StackAdapt also had the honour of sponsoring 15 girls to attend the Technovation World Summit in Santa Clara, California, this year.

facts.fact: StackAdapt donated a tree to One Tree Planted for each staff member who joined its Earth Day digital cleanup, contributing over 45 trees.
facts.quote: For each staff member who joined the digital cleanup event, StackAdapt donated a tree to One Tree Planted, a non-profit organization focused on global reforestation, contributing over 45 trees.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Stack the Future initiative provides scholarship funding to post-secondary institutions, including a StackAdapt Engineering Entrance Bursary at the University of Waterloo.
facts.quote: Our annual Stack the Future initiative continues to be a highlight of our community engagement, providing scholarship funding to post-secondary institutions.

facts.fact: StackAdapt plans to broaden its community partnerships across the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions in 2025.
facts.quote: In 2025, we plan to broaden our community partnerships across the EMEA, APAC, and NA regions.
